# Vivek Anand

> Personal site of Vivek Anand, from Kerai, a village in Bihar, India. Software engineering is part of his life alongside cricket, table tennis, morning walks, and chai.

Vivek works remotely from home. Professionally, he is a software engineer mostly working in backend development, building systems and leading teams across fintech, healthtech, and B2B SaaS. He captained IIIT Allahabad’s cricket team, which won the college’s first tournament trophy in 2017.

## Personal site

- [Introduction](https://anandvivek.in/): Personal background and interests.
- [Experience](https://anandvivek.in/#experience): Work at Virtual Internships, Barq, Innovaccer, PaySense, Ethereal Machines, and contributions to Pagure.
- [Technical practice](https://anandvivek.in/#skills): Languages, frameworks, infrastructure, and applied AI.
- [Contact](https://anandvivek.in/#contact): Contact details and social profiles.
